events.verdict: Williams (DAL) brings his left arm forward and initiates contact with Portis' (MIL) body prior to making any contact with the ball.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) moves his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) brings his right elbow towards Gafford's (DAL) side as he gathers the ball, and the contact is marginal.
Gafford (DAL) is moving alongside Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path when marginal contact occurs as he comes together with Antetokounmpo during the driving shot attempt.
Kuzma's (MIL) briefly grasps Williams' (DAL) jersey as he elevates to pursue the rebound.
Flagg (DAL) establishes himself in Rollins' (MIL) path and does not deliver contact.

Washington (DAL) turns slightly towards Kuzma (MIL) as he contests the shot attempt. This contact, which occurs prior to the shot being blocked by Christie (DAL), is considered marginal. After the shot is blocked, Washington's arm continues moving downward and contact occurs with Kuzma's head/face, which is considered marginal. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Christie (DAL) cleanly blocks Kuzma's (MIL) shot attempt.
Rollins (MIL) brushes Williams' (DAL) arm, which causes Williams to momentarily lose control of the ball before he quickly regains possession.
Gafford (DAL) steps into Antetokounmpo's (MIL) left side on his drive and reaches across his body, making contact with his wrist/arm.
Kuzma (MIL) momentarily applies his hand to Flagg's (DAL) front, and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Flagg (DAL) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes more than two steps after his gather.
Kuzma (MIL) moves forward into Flagg's (DAL) space and initiates body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Rollins (MIL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Portis (MIL) and Marshall (DAL) briefly engage and disengage as they position themselves for the rebound, and Marshall loses his balance on his own accord.

Antetokounmpo (MIL) jumps vertically into the air and absorbs the contact with Flagg (DAL) while in the air. Antetokounmpo then brings his right arm down towards the ball and avoids making any contact with Flagg's arm while contesting the driving shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) momentarily grasps and releases Washington's (DAL) left arm and the contact off-ball is marginal.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Rollins' (MIL) driving shot attempt at the basket.
Washington (DAL) avoids making any contact with Rollins' (MIL) arm as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Although Flagg (DAL) slips on his own accord, Kuzma (MIL) tugs down on his jersey before he turns around the screen.
Rollins (MIL) legally contests Christie's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Williams (DAL) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.

Antetokounmpo (MIL) initially makes contact with the ball during Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt, however he does not dislodge the ball from Washington.  Antetokounmpo then slides his hand off the ball and onto Washington's wrist, initiating contact which affects his jump shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly grasps Cisse's (DAL) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
Kuzma (MIL) momentarily brings his hand to Flagg's (DAL) lower back as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
